passenger_name_bounds.name: passenger_name_bounds
passenger_name_bounds.value: "booking_items"."passenger_name" IS NULL OR (length("booking_items"."passenger_name") BETWEEN 2 AND 100 AND "booking_items"."passenger_name"=btrim("booking_items"."passenger_name") AND "booking_items"."passenger_name" !~ '[[:cntrl:]]')

booking_details_bounds.name: booking_details_bounds
booking_details_bounds.value: "bookings"."version">0 AND (("bookings"."pickup_stop_id" IS NULL AND "bookings"."drop_stop_id" IS NULL) OR ("bookings"."pickup_stop_id" IS NOT NULL AND "bookings"."drop_stop_id" IS NOT NULL AND "bookings"."pickup_stop_id"<>"bookings"."drop_stop_id")) AND ("bookings"."contact_email" IS NULL OR length("bookings"."contact_email") BETWEEN 3 AND 254) AND ("bookings"."contact_phone" IS NULL OR "bookings"."contact_phone" ~ '^[+][1-9][0-9]{6,14}$')

trip_catalog_pair.name: trip_catalog_pair
trip_catalog_pair.value: ("trips"."route_id" IS NULL AND "trips"."origin_city_id" IS NULL AND "trips"."destination_city_id" IS NULL) OR ("trips"."route_id" IS NOT NULL AND "trips"."origin_city_id" IS NOT NULL AND "trips"."destination_city_id" IS NOT NULL)

payment_job_lease.name: payment_job_lease
payment_job_lease.value: ("payment_jobs"."state"='RUNNING') = ("payment_jobs"."lease_token" IS NOT NULL AND "payment_jobs"."lease_expires_at" IS NOT NULL)

checkout_ready_order.name: checkout_ready_order
checkout_ready_order.value: "checkout_attempts"."state" NOT IN ('READY','CAPTURED') OR "checkout_attempts"."order_id" IS NOT NULL

payment_case_bounds.name: payment_case_bounds
payment_case_bounds.value: length("payment_cases"."case_key") BETWEEN 1 AND 180 AND "payment_cases"."reason" IN ('ORDER_AMBIGUOUS','MONEY_MISMATCH','UNMAPPED_EVENT','EVENT_HASH_MISMATCH','REFUND_UNCERTAIN','REFUND_FAILED','RETRY_EXHAUSTED','ALLOCATION_MISMATCH') AND "payment_cases"."state" IN ('OPEN','RESOLVED')

inbox_event_bounds.name: inbox_event_bounds
inbox_event_bounds.value: length("payment_inbox"."event_id") BETWEEN 1 AND 100 AND length("payment_inbox"."event_type") BETWEEN 1 AND 80 AND "payment_inbox"."payload_hash" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'

service_seat_bounds.name: service_seat_bounds
service_seat_bounds.value: "inventory_service_seats"."position" BETWEEN 1 AND 80 AND "inventory_service_seats"."fare_minor" BETWEEN 1 AND 2500000 AND "inventory_service_seats"."label" ~ '^[0-9]{1,2}[A-D]$'

service_stop_bounds.name: service_stop_bounds
service_stop_bounds.value: "inventory_service_stops"."role" IN ('PICKUP','DROP') AND "inventory_service_stops"."sequence" BETWEEN 1 AND 20 AND "inventory_service_stops"."offset_minutes" BETWEEN 0 AND 4320

service_cities.name: service_cities
service_cities.value: length("inventory_services"."origin") BETWEEN 1 AND 100 AND length("inventory_services"."destination") BETWEEN 1 AND 100 AND "inventory_services"."origin"<>"inventory_services"."destination"

service_bounds.name: service_bounds
service_bounds.value: "inventory_services"."travel_minutes" BETWEEN 1 AND 4320 AND "inventory_services"."sales_lead_minutes" BETWEEN 2 AND 1440 AND "inventory_services"."seat_count" BETWEEN 1 AND 80
